description: This file contains a utility function named build_related_list_by_user_id to retrieve related records associated with a specific user ID in the SuiteCRM system. It builds and executes SQL queries based on whether the bean has a relationship table or not, processes the results, and returns a list of bean objects.

methods.name: build_related_list_by_user_id
methods.description: Retrieves a list of related bean objects for a given user ID, based on the relationship table or assigned user ID, executing the appropriate SQL query and processing the result set.
